subject: cork-tailed lizard
art_direction: 柔绿小蜥的尾巴是巨大的盘绕木塞，身体倚着尾圈，厚线条与皮革拼接感。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Invent a friendly lizard with a soft sage leather body and an oversized spiral tail carved from cork. The creature leans against its own tail loop, resting one short hand on its hip with an unhurried smirk. Give it a rounded snout and small leaf-shaped feet rather than realistic scales. Use visible leather seams, a few embossed patches, and open cork pores to distinguish materials. Place it on a cream field with a soft side shadow. Keep the head, belly, and tail as three broad interlocking shapes. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
